# Wajid Ali

> Senior software engineer (5+ years) building scalable systems, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, and AI-first products. Open to senior/staff engineering roles — full-time remote, or on-site with relocation and sponsorship — across the Gulf (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain), Pakistan, USA, UK, and Malaysia.

Core stack: TypeScript, C#/.NET, Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, and LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI). Has taken three SaaS products from prototype to paying, multi-tenant production; led teams of 3-6 engineers; owned production on-call; mentored 12 engineers.

"Scalable systems" means capacity that's a config change, not a rewrite: stateless services, idempotent workers, explicit backpressure, load-tested SLOs. "AI-first" means the LLM is a component with a contract — inspectable retrieval, structured outputs, evals in CI, cost/latency budgets, defined fallbacks — not a chatbot bolted onto a CRUD app.

## Engineering services

Wajid Ali offers website design/redesign and performance work, custom SaaS and business software, and AI automation/integration. Website packages start from PKR 45,000, PKR 95,000 and PKR 175,000; final scope and pricing require a written quote. Software and automation are discovery-priced. Independent redesigns are demonstrations, not commissioned client engagements. MCPOF is an owner-described local engineering framework with implementation evidence pending, not a deployed client product.
